The native snapshot binds descriptors and the revision. Invalid-cache retirement is conditional on that exact revision. A delayed lookup cannot retire or publish over a newer invalidation.

All native descriptor/diagnostic publication sites use the expected native revision. Bootstrap refresh rejects an invalidated in-flight descriptor read before publishing it; the synchronous storage fallback also rejects a reentrant invalidation before caching its captured rows.
The original separate Type relation revision mechanism remains intact; native descriptor revision is not misused as a Type write identity.

Picker result owns its properties and failures. The production loader consumes that call-specific failure dictionary after await instead of rereading shared lastLookupDiagnostics, while the existing public convenience API still returns the original descriptor array.
